purpose: Teach: 逐次/紀元前/派兵/軽蔑/露呈/否決/法務大臣/会計検査院

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、証拠を逐次集めております
lines.en: We're gathering evidence in this case systematically.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady pace. No inflection—a statement of fact. Hands steady on the desk. The voice of procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、紀元前の遺物の盗難を捜査中ですね
lines.en: So the police are investigating the theft of ancient artifacts.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly probing. Gentle upturn at the end—checking his understanding, not challenging. Quiet curiosity underneath. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、国外派兵時の警備事案にも対応します
lines.en: We also respond to security incidents related to overseas deployments.
lines.style: Even cadence, each phrase weighted equally. Professional distance. The voice of someone reading from a comprehensive scope of work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者への軽蔑発言を警察、調査されましたね
lines.en: So you investigated the contemptuous remarks directed at the victim.
lines.style: Careful, precise. A slight pause before 'contemptuous'—choosing the right word matters here. Not accusatory, just confirming. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、組織内不正の露呈を厳格に対応します
lines.en: We take internal fraud seriously when it comes to light.
lines.style: Firmer edge now. A slight tightening on 'seriously.' No apology in the voice. Direct, measured anger held in check.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、議会で否決された法案について警察、所感がおありですね
lines.en: As for the bill that didn't pass in the Diet, I'd have to defer on that.
lines.style: A breath before answering—this is outside his lane. Honest admission of boundary. Respectful, not evasive. Slight pause after 'defer.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、法務大臣のご指示を仰ぎます
lines.en: We follow the Justice Minister's direction on this.
lines.style: Clipped, formal. This closes the door politely. The voice of deference to hierarchy, not uncertainty. Clean and final.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、会計検査院との連携、警察、強化されましたね
lines.en: We've strengthened our coordination with the Audit Board on this case.
lines.style: Warm, almost relieved. A slight softening from the earlier procedural tone. This is partnership, not just protocol. Genuine acknowledgment of a working relationship.
